items.summary_short: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires AI systems that improve the process of building AI (i.e., AI4AI); machine learning engineering (MLE) offers a concrete, executable testbed for studying this capability.

items.title: Beacon: Knowing When and How to Perform Agentic Visual Reasoning
items.summary_short: The fundamental goal of agentic visual reasoning is to improve the success rate of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on complex tasks, rather than merely equipping them with a sophisticated yet inefficient reasoning paradigm.
items.spotlight_comment: The fundamental goal of agentic visual reasoning is to improve the success rate of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on complex tasks, rather than merely equipping them with a sophisticated yet inefficient reasoning paradigm.

items.title: BM25 Wins at Scale: A Scaling Study of Retrieval-Augmented Generation Paradigms
items.summary_short: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) spans lexical and dense retrieval, graph-based indexing, and agentic search, but these paradigms are usually evaluated on different benchmarks at one corpus size, leaving their accuracy-cost scaling unclear.
items.spotlight_comment: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) spans lexical and dense retrieval, graph-based indexing, and agentic search, but these paradigms are usually evaluated on different benchmarks at one corpus size, leaving their accuracy-cost scaling unclear.

items.title: MPIE-Bench: Benchmarking Anatomically Plausible Multi-Person Interaction Editing
items.summary_short: Text-to-image and personalized editing models now synthesize high-fidelity single-subject images with ease. Yet placing multiple named people into shared contact actions such as embrace, carry, or grapple still exposes major failures: fused limbs, invented extremities, and interpenetrating bodies.
items.spotlight_comment: Text-to-image and personalized editing models now synthesize high-fidelity single-subject images with ease.

items.title: ACE-Data-0: Human-Centric Ambient Capture as Embodied Data Engine
items.summary_short: Embodied intelligence faces a fundamental data bottleneck. Models must capture how first-person perception, whole-body motion, dexterous manipulation, object state, sound, and touch evolve together as humans pursue goals over time.
items.spotlight_comment: Embodied intelligence faces a fundamental data bottleneck. Models must capture how first-person perception, whole-body motion, dexterous manipulation, object state, sound, and touch evolve together as humans pursue goals over time.

items.title: Memory Decoder at Scale: A Pretrained, Parametric Long-Term Memory
items.summary_short: Decoder-only language models entangle long-term memory and reasoning in a single parameter set, making it difficult to scale memory capacity independently. Memory Decoder introduces a parametric long-term memory module but only studies it at a relatively small scale.
items.spotlight_comment: Decoder-only language models entangle long-term memory and reasoning in a single parameter set, making it difficult to scale memory capacity independently.

items.summary_short: Large language model training in open-ended domains lacks verifiable rewards, making task preferences difficult to formalize as effective supervision.
